findings.text: Global cache sizing entry populates per CPU cache and translation sizes from extended identification information and tolerates missing second level caches plus platform adjustments.
Global AMD cache leaf initializer sets the leaf count from topology extension when present, otherwise from a small fixed count derived from extended level support.
Global null segment check decides a CPU bug flag from build mode, advertised support, virtualization, family and a direct hardware probe of selector behavior.
Global Zen speculation control enables a vendor chicken bit on bare metal when the relevant entry mitigation is configured.
Global debug mask accessors expose per CPU breakpoint extension masks, updating hardware only on change and reporting zero when unsupported or out of range.
Global microcode recheck reevaluates the Zenbleed workaround on every CPU when boot vendor and generation indicate an affected part.
AMD setup selects legacy family handlers by family number and Zen generation handlers by boot generation flags, with common Zen setup for newer families before cache and feature fixups.
Hardware mitigation writes are skipped when virtualized, including speculation, predictor, prefetch and direct probe paths, avoiding action on emulated state.
Errata workarounds are gated by minimum microcode revisions, applying feature hiding or register toggles only when current microcode predates the fix.
Feature and bug flags are normalized through implications and corrections, enabling beneficial capabilities and marking bugs when prerequisites hold.
First Zen generation combines division and floating point mitigations with a bare metal capability correction and withdrawal of a performance counter on early models.
Second Zen generation combines spectral, save and bleed mitigations with model specific random number withdrawal, invalidate hiding and a bare metal predictor fix.

Later Zen generations apply bare metal predictor and confusion hardening, hide virtualized save on listed system on chip models, and gate random number plus translation shootdown bugs by revision and capability.
Cache leaf enumeration iterates sequential subleaves from zero until a null type appears, using an AMD style base leaf for AMD and Hygon parts.
Level sizing separates first level contributions from second level unified size, with special inclusive cache handling and legacy override paths on some builds.
Null selector probe preserves the FS base across a zero selector load and treats a cleared result as the fast behavior.
Translation sizing needs a minimum family and extended level, prefers second level counts with first level fallback, applies a model correction and halves counts for larger page sizes.
Debug mask updates are suppressed when the extension is off, the index is out of range, or the stored value already matches, with out of range reported once.
Level three disable writes reject occupied slots, duplicate indices across slots and oversized indices, and require administrative privilege.
Enhanced restricted speculation mode is recognized as any of three related mitigation enumeration values.
Virtualization capability is withdrawn with a one time notice when firmware control state indicates a BIOS requested disable.
Extended control register bits for automatic branch protection and translation extension are enabled only when supported, with branch protection further gated by mitigation mode.
Reset status reporting ignores an all set error value and clears retained reasons by writing the observed value back because bits clear on write one.
Additional DMI scanning validates record type, header length, entry count and entry framing before searching for a firmware version string by short prefix.
AMD device descriptor binds vendor and identifier strings to early, translation, bootstrap and general callbacks, plus legacy naming and cache hooks on some builds.
Minimum microcode tables pair family, model and stepping patterns with least fixed revisions and end with an empty terminator.
Reset reason table is sparse by bit position where defined positions describe thermal, power, reset, software, watchdog, fabric and parity causes and gaps stay empty.
Debug mask state holds four unsigned entries per CPU plus a parallel table of mask register identifiers used for programming.
Level three geometry tracks per subcache presence counts and a maximum disable index derived from the largest subcache size scaled to index range.
Disable index programming proceeds per present subcache from armed to committed state with a node scoped flush between phases, encoding slot, subcache and index.
Each disable slot is free or bound to an index, reads report bound index or a free marker, writes bind once and no unbind path is shown.
Bleed workaround state is evaluated per CPU and globally after microcode load, engaging the fix on old microcode and disengaging on current, skipped without vector support or when virtualized.
Main AMD CPU initialization combines early setup, family and generation dispatch, cache and node discovery, virtualization validation and feature plus register fixups.
Per slot attribute operations delegate to shared show and store helpers parameterized by slot number, translating device context to cache and northbridge state.
Boot reporting entries expose prior reset causes from chipset status and firmware version from DMI, running once and silent when prerequisites are absent.
Register and cache operations depend on CPU and node context, including node scoped flushes for level three changes and local CPU use for masks and status reads.
Capability and mitigation decisions must distrust emulated topology under a hypervisor, so direct probes and model fixes are bypassed or treated as vulnerable when virtualized.
Known unreliable features are forcibly hidden on affected models or revisions, including random number, save, broadcast invalidate and virtualized save variants.
Facts: first level sizing from extended leaf 80000005, second level from 80000006, invalidate maximum from 80000008, enumeration from 8000001D on AMD style versus leaf 4 elsewhere.
Facts: subcache presence from config offset 1C4 with first pair on bits 0 and 4 plus bits 1 and 5 on family 15, others on bits 8 with 9 and 12 with 13, slots at 1BC plus slot times four.
Facts: slot state in upper two bits of slot register with index in low twelve bits, programming uses lower commit and upper enable phases around a flush.
Facts: prior reset status is 32 bits from power management base plus status offset, all ones means ignore, reasons are bit indexed and cleared by writing one.

Facts: reset bits zero to two for thermal pin, power button and shutdown pin, bit four remote off, bit nine thermal limit, bits sixteen to twenty seven for reset and software causes, bits twenty nine to thirty one for handshake, parity and flood.
Facts: four debug masks per CPU indexed zero to three through four mask registers anchored at the family 16h zero register.
Facts: random hide clears CPUID function 7 bit 18, unreliable on hex model 47 step zero and on listed Zen5 revisions, performance counter quirk below hex model 30.
Facts: virtualized save hidden for hex model ranges 18 to 1F and 60 to 7F, translation quirk value 1024 for hex family 15 models up to hex 1F.
Facts: string optimization from hex family 10 onward, running timer above hex family 11, machine check hidden below family 6, translation detection from hex family F, common Zen from hex family 17.
Facts: vendor display AMD with identifier AuthenticAMD for device matching, plus legacy 486 family naming on 32 bit builds.

Facts: bleed minima for hex family 17 are model 31 step 0 revision 0830107b, model 60 step 1 revision 0860010c, model 68 step 1 revision 08608107, model 71 step 0 revision 08701033, model A0 step 0 revision 08A00009.
Facts: Zen5 random minima for hex family 1A cover models 02, 08, 11, 24, 44 twice, 60, 68 and 70 with paired stepping and revision values ending in a terminator.
